messages:
sarah: FYI — customer reported being charged twice when a streaming session resumed after a short disconnect. looks tied to a toolcall in-flight and a heartbeat / snapshot race. attaching snippets below.

miguel: can you paste the minimal log sequence? is this reproable in staging? :thinking: 

sarah: repro came from prod but we have a staging trace. snippet: 
```
2026-03-02T16:12:01Z STREAM_START session=ss-8a1
2026-03-02T16:12:02Z TOOL_CALL start tool_id=translate ttl=30 call_id=tc-77
2026-03-02T16:12:07Z HEARTBEAT session=ss-8a1 ledger_state=provisional tokens=120
2026-03-02T16:12:09Z CONNECTION_DROP session=ss-8a1
2026-03-02T16:12:11Z RESUME session=ss-8a1 resume_token=r-44
2026-03-02T16:12:12Z CHUNK_TRUNCATED session=ss-8a1 reason=client-trim
2026-03-02T16:12:13Z TOOL_CALL_COMPLETE call_id=tc-77 tokens=120
2026-03-02T16:12:13Z BILLING_COMMIT session=ss-8a1 billed=240
```

priya: whoa. looks like the provisional 120 from heartbeat + the 120 from tool completion both became committed. are we double-applying provisional entries on resume? :eyes: 

kevin: likely. runtime currently emits a provisional ledger event on HEARTBEAT and marks it confirmed when it sees tool completion or stream close. resume path replays buffered chunks and the ledger reconciler treats the replayed tool_complete as new confirmation, but the provisional entry was never cleared because truncation changed offsets. race = provisional left + replayed confirmation -> double apply.

lucy: that matches a support ticket where client trimmed prefix and we kept provisional tokens for that prefix. UX-wise we should surface "provisional" vs "confirmed" tokens in the console per-session. helps customers understand temporary charges.

miguel: proposals: 
- ledger dedupe by (session_id, call_id, sequence_id) when applying confirms
- make tool_call idempotent (accept call_id from client) so replayed completions are ignored
- on resume, if truncation happened, reconcile provisional entries by comparing prefix checksums

priya: favor explicit idempotency + telemetry. dedupe heuristics are brittle across rollouts. also need a migration story for existing provisional rows.

kevin: agree on idempotent tool_call API. short-term patch: ignore confirm events if there's an outstanding provisional with identical tokens and overlapping offsets and last_heartbeat_ts < X seconds. throttles some false positives but buys time.

lucy: for console/dashboard: add a new metric stream.provisional_tokens and a per-session timeline of lifecycle events (start, heartbeat, tool_start, drop, resume, truncation, confirm, commit). can we plumb that telemetry easily?

ops-bot: deploy-grafana: created dashboard draft: stream-token-lifecycle (panels: provisional vs confirmed, per-session events).

miguel: owners? kevin + priya to spec API + ledger changes. lucy to draft UX. i'll add an RFC for the idempotent tool_call shape and a short-term runtime guard.

sarah: thanks all. filing a support response that we're working on an idempotent-call fix + console visibility. will follow up with repro PR soon. :v:
